doc: Human reactions (lane human-reactions): the cutout rig's reaction and death families. len_s is the length of the animation (a death holds its last pose as the corpse), travel_m how far the body is drawn along the hit at the peak. View only: never sim state, never hashed.

reactions.doc: Light round: head and torso snap away from the hit, an arm comes up.
Heavy round: steps back along the hit, the weapon arm drops.
Blast or tackle: falls along the hit, slides, lies 1.4 s, gets up.
Riot shield block from the front: recoils behind the shield.
Melee from the side: a half spin away from the blow.
Melee from the front: folds over the blow.
Electro: convulses in place, the hat jolting.
Burning: flails, arms up, head thrashing (the host runs the body).
Hit while in cover: ducks and flinches small.
A pedestrian startled by gunfire (the sim's FLEE onset, CrowdReact): ducks, hands over the head, hops away from the bang, then the flight runs on.
Round kill: falls back from the front, crumples forward from behind.
Melee kill: folds over, then topples along the blow.
Blast kill: thrown along the blast, tumbling.
Burn kill: flails, then collapses charred.
Electro kill: convulses, then falls stiff as a plank.
